cases.sentence: Он делал то, что было правильным в глазах Господа, как и его отец Уззия, но в отличие от него он не вторгался в ___.
cases.explain: «Господень храм» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into Yahweh’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

cases.explain: «скверные обычаи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into Yahweh’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

cases.sentence: Иотам перестроил ___ Господнего дома и выполнил большие работы у городской стены на холме Офел.
cases.explain: «Верхние ворота» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

cases.translation: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

cases.sentence: Иотам перестроил Верхние ворота Господнего дома и выполнил большие работы у ___ на холме Офел.
cases.explain: «городской стены» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

cases.sentence: Он строил города в ___ и крепости с башнями в лесистых местностях.
cases.explain: «иудейских горах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

cases.sentence: ___ правления Иотама, все его войны и другие деяния записаны в «Книге царей Израиля и Иудеи».
cases.explain: «Прочие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
